reactor_type: travelling-wave type reactor (CN-1 Co., Atomic Classic)
evidence: HfO2 thin ﬁlms were grown by ALD using a travelling-wave type reactor (CN-1 Co., Atomic Classic). The ﬁlms were grown on (0 0 1) Si and sputtered Pt(100 nm)/Ti(50 nm)/SiO2(300 nm)/Si substrates at a temperature range of 175–325 ◦C. Ar was used as a purging and carrier gas.
